rationale: RGTX has gapped up 15.5% on a 4.49M share float with 95x relative volume, indicating a significant catalyst-driven squeeze; the last three 5-minute candles show accelerating price and volume with the price recovering to 91% of the intraday range and holding above the 5-min VWAP ($10.25) and 9-EMA ($10.42), suggesting buyers remain in control.
